turns.question: What was the 90th percentile order amount in EUR for all orders placed between 17 August and 2 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no 90th-percentile order amount metric. The closest metrics are Average order value (EUR) (average_order_value_eur) and Revenue (EUR) (revenue_eur); Median order value (EUR) exists only on BigQuery and is not available here.
